briefdescription.para: Remove the constant from the constant table.
Return a ConstantVector with the specified constant in each element.

detaileddescription.para: Note that this might not return an instance of ConstantVector

briefdescription.para: Methods for support type inquiry through isa, cast, and dyn_cast:
Specialize the getType() method to always return a FixedVectorType, which reduces the amount of casting needed in parts of the compiler.
If all elements of the vector constant have the same value, return that value.

detaileddescription.para: Otherwise, return nullptr. Ignore poison elements by setting AllowPoison to true.
